## JSP-001050 · Effective Mordell conjecture for curves of genus at least two

| Field | Content |
| --- | --- |
| Date proposed | Not independently established; public-source confirmation pending. |
| Mathematical area | Arithmetic geometry / Diophantine geometry |
| Problem description | Construct an algorithm that, given a number field K, a smooth projective geometrically connected curve X/K of genus at least two and a finite number-field extension L/K, computes the complete finite set X(L). This algorithmic effective-Mordell form supplies an effectively computable height bound for each input curve and field; qualitative finiteness alone is insufficient. A prescribed linear or polynomial uniform height bound is a stronger formulation and requires an explicit scope decision. |

Stronger quantitative reference: [MathDB #318788 — Strong Mordell for families](https://mathdb.com/p/318788/strong-mordell-conjecture-for-families-of-curves); that family-uniform bound is not automatically included in this record.
